newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuba heading for record tourist numbers in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Cuba heading for record tourist numbers in 1996.

text.p: Cuba is heading toward record visitor numbers for 1996, state media said on Friday, with about 789,000 foreign tourists visiting Cuba between January and October.

The ruling Communist Party newspaper Granma said the figure compared with a total of 740,000 visitors for the whole of 1995. Cuba has seen a steady increase in tourist numbers since authorities began expanding the sector from the early 1990s.
Italians were the largest group of visitors for the January-October period, followed by Canadians, Spaniards and Germans.
With the high season -- the northern winter -- just about to start, authorities expect to finish the year with around 900,000 to 1 million visitors.
